goals: Convert recruiters and engineering managers for full-time senior frontend roles
Present Rimil as design-minded, product-aware, and technically rigorous

references.name: Vogue
references.reason: Confident typography, strong pacing, editorial rhythm

references.name: Shopify Editions Winter 2026
references.reason: Premium composition, storytelling density, polished digital publication feel

antiPatterns: template-like hero with generic headshot and skill pills
dashboard-style metric tiles as the dominant visual language
developer rainbow gradients and glowing dark UI
dense badge clouds for tech stack
hover-only interactions or hidden critical content

siteConcept.name: The Editorial Dossier
siteConcept.summary: A single-page portfolio composed like a personal editorial dossier: an opening statement, a current chapter, selected evidence, a career ledger, and a quiet closing contact section.
whyThisDirection: A single-page flow reduces recruiter friction and keeps narrative control tight
Editorial sequencing suits Rimil's calm premium positioning better than standard three-page portfolio templates
The structure lets impact and taste lead before raw chronology

typography.displayIntent: high-contrast editorial serif with graceful curves
typography.bodyIntent: refined readable sans with neutral warmth
notes: Use a distinctive display face and separate body face
Use fluid editorial sizing for major headings only

shapeLanguage.corners: mostly square with occasional soft 12-16px radii on media
shapeLanguage.borders: hairline rules and section dividers over heavy cards
shapeLanguage.shadows: minimal; rely on contrast and rhythm first

motion.reducedMotion: all non-essential transitions collapse to instant
notes: No layout animation for primary content
Micro-interactions should feel editorial, not app-like

responsive: single-column reading flow on small screens
selective multi-column editorial moments on tablet and desktop
performance: avoid layout shift and heavy animation libs
